facts.fact: The Zimbabwe Geoportal lists a ZimSTATS dataset described as an extract from the 2023 National Census findings for district populations.
The Zimbabwe Geoportal lists a ZimSTATS dataset, 2023 Adm2 (District) Population by Age Group, an extract from the 2023 National Census findings, dated 28 January 2026.

ZWE.note: Only a municipal cadastral layer dataset for Marondera is listed; no land register system stated.
Page states no local government office connection.
